topic: Day 113 — reel — Real closeness is measured by who stayed through your failures
text:
Closeness is
measured by who
stayed through
the [losing].
caption:
Anyone can be present for the good stretch. The much smaller group who watched it go badly and stayed is the real count.

Follow for one of these a day.
